Question: Premise: The 26-member International Energy Agency said, Friday, that member countries would release oil to help relieve the U.S. fuel crisis caused by Hurricane Katrina., Hypothesis: An international oil agency will make 60 million barrels of oil and gasoline available to the marketplace.

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct choice.
